ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-distribution; approximately 88% high-intensity (white) surface area vs 12% low-intensity (black) peripheral banding.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white field across central and medial regions; continuous black banding along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips; one dark focal cluster at the proximal center-base/peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees with a depth of roughly 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jaggedness along the continuous boundary; serration amplitude is highest at the distal thirds of both lobes with pixel-peaks ranging from 4-8 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve fitting; convex trajectory from the notch transitioning to a concave mid-section and terminal convex rounding at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical dark linear mark approximately 15 pixels in length located at the lower center-base of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small hook-shaped dark pigment mark at the central base; multiple faint circular surface depressions (dimples) visible on the medial-right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric distribution of black pigment on the terminal tips, with the right tip displaying a broader and more irregular black pixel cluster compared to the left.
